==Description==
The '''Barricade''' is one of the four common [[Consumables|consumables]]. It has a 16.67% (16.22% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]] and a 9.23% (7.06% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]].

Only up to four '''Barricades''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 30 second cooldown, though when the match first starts the cooldown is set to 45 seconds.

==Usage==
When using the '''Barricade''', the player's avatar's right hand will hold a hammer, throw into the air and then catch it, playing a custom idle animation. The player can then select a place to build the barricade, which places it down and can take up to 300 damage before being destroyed. Enemies do not deal increased damage to it if they have defense. It can deal damage to [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies but it is unable to deal damage to [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies, though it can still receive damage from them. Enemies which have the same or higher health than the '''Barricade''' will instantly destroy it while receiving no damage. For high health enemies like [[Normal Boss]] which have a higher health than the '''Barricade''', if it is reduced to health that is lower than it the '''Barricade''' will still be destroyed, however, the [[Normal Boss]] will receive some damage which will be lower than the '''Barricade's''' health.

==Appearance==
The '''Barricade''' is a pile of 18 tan sand bags stacked to make a wall, with a wooden crossbeam constructed behind it. The wooden crossbeam has a long coil of barbed wire attached to it.

==Strategy==
*A single '''Barricade''' is able to take several early-game waves before breaking. Due to this, building a barricade can allow for time to farm and earn extra cash without needing to place extra towers to defend against enemies.
**You can place multiple '''Barricades''' to wall off even more enemies, up to four for a total of 800 health, and even more if other players also use the '''Barricade'''.
**This strategy does not pair well with the [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]], as the '''Barricade''' may kill enemies that they would have shot to generate cash. If you do decide to use it in this situation, place the '''Barricade''' outside of the range of the towers so as to not waste any cash.
*The '''Barricade''' can also be placed to prevent enemies from going past a certain point and leaking if your defense is weak.
